satellites.title: The Sun Is the Full
satellites.evidence: The Shuowen defines by sound: 日，實也。太陽之精不虧 — “日 is 實, the full: the essence of great yang, which never wanes.” Its partner is 月，闕也, “月 is 闕, the wanting.” Sun and moon are glossed by words that sound like them and name their difference.
satellites.caveat: A sound gloss (聲訓) is Han hermeneutics, not historical etymology.
